_comment: Joint positions in degrees. Order: [shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll, gripper]. poses.home [0,0,0,90,-90,0] is the HOME/return (END) pose -- the Y-button target and the eval '3_home' target, arm extended over the table. Shipped as a package resource so the home pose does not silently fall back to the environment default. Values carried over from the thesis workspace config/hardware/lerobot_master_config.json.
